visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women are seen in a bathroom mirror selfie. The woman on the left has dark hair, wearing a grey sleeveless top and dark blue leggings. The woman on the right wears a black vest over a white ruffled dress. They are both smiling and posing with peace signs. Background features wooden partitions and a white sink countertop. (2) A sudden cut shows the same two women in the same bathroom setting, but they have switched into elegant, floor-length white off-the-shoulder dresses with thigh-high slits. They continue to smile and gesture at the mirror while the woman on the left records with her phone. (3) The scene shifts to a restaurant or event hall. The camera follows from behind as the two women in white gowns walk toward a stage. Guests are seated at tables with white linens. Warm lighting from a chandelier and candles creates a formal atmosphere. (4) The women are now on a stage in front of a red velvet curtain. The woman on the left plays a silver flute, while the woman on the right plays a violin. Microphones on stands are positioned in front of them. Festive 'Happy Halloween' balloons and a witch hat decoration are visible. (5) A close-up shows the flutist performing with closed eyes, followed by a brief selfie-style shot where both women smile broadly at the camera. The background is a bright indoor setting with neutral curtains.
